root_cause_label: Agent interrupted apt-get installation with invalid C-c command, breaking terminal state and rendering all subsequent commands ineffective
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent confused itself by issuing invalid interrupt commands (C-c typed as a shell command rather than a keystroke) while apt-get was installing pandas, breaking the terminal session so that every subsequent command from step 17 onward produced no output and result.csv was never created.
t_err_evidence: Step 10: agent issues 'C-c' as a literal shell command attempting to interrupt apt-get, but 'C-c' is not a valid shell command and has no effect; simultaneously the agent wrongly believes apt-get is still running when the terminal output was already showing unrelated directory listings (steps 7, 9). This mishandling of the environment obstacle sets the terminal into a confused state.
t_commit_evidence: Step 17: agent writes transform.py using heredoc but terminal output shows '(command not found in terminal output)', and from this point onward every single command (steps 18-34) returns '(command not found in terminal output)', indicating the terminal session is fully broken and no commands are being executed or producing output. The script may never have been written to disk.
t_surface_evidence: Step 19: terminal output shows 'Traceback (most recent call last):' — the first observable error signal from attempting to run transform.py, suggesting the script either does not exist or encountered an error during execution.
trigger_explanation: The apt-get installation of python3-pandas (a real environment obstacle — 170MB download, slow network) was a valid approach, but the agent misread the terminal state: while apt-get appeared to still be running in step 8, by steps 7 and 9 the terminal was showing unrelated directory and CSV content, suggesting the process had completed or the session was already confused. The agent then issued 'C-c' as a literal shell command (steps 10, 14) and other invalid commands (killall, clear repeatedly), further destabilizing the session instead of waiting for apt to finish or switching to a pure-Python csv-based implementation.
forewarning_evidence: Step 7: agent issues 'N/A' (no command) and sees directory listing instead of apt-get progress, misreading it as installation still running. Steps 9: another N/A with CSV content shown instead of apt output. Steps 11-16: repeated confusion, clearing terminal multiple times, misidentifying terminal state. Step 14 agent says 'still running in the background' with no evidence.
